basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a high school junior from Round Rock, Texas. I'm super into gaming, especially anything related to 100 Thieves. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy watching animation reviews on RebelTaxi and keeping up with the latest memes. I usually browse Reddit after school and late into the night, especially on weekends. I'm not in a relationship right now, but I love hanging out with my friends IRL and online. I'm also a big fan of Mexican music and often visit RegiasMx for the latest updates.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm mostly self-taught when it comes to gaming and tech. I love watching YouTube tutorials and streams to pick up new skills and strategies. I've been part of a few online communities where I learn through discussions and trial and error.
